text: This looks like Potato leafroll and mosaic viruses. I do not have a verified medicine to give you for it, so please do not spray anything on guesswork. There are things you can do today. 1. Plant certified virus-free seed. This is the single decisive measure. 2. Follow the seed plot technique: raise the seed crop in the low-aphid winter window and dehaulm before aphid numbers cross the critical threshold. 3. Rogue out symptomatic plants early and repeatedly. For a spray, ask your Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
